requirements.requirement: The system must normalize binary measures by mapping true/positive values to 1 and false/negative values to 0.
The system must normalize categorical measures using a configuration-defined mapping from category values to numeric scores.
The system must normalize continuous measures using min-max scaling when specified in configuration.
The system must normalize continuous measures using z-score normalization when specified in configuration.
The system must output normalized values on a standardized 0 to 1 scale unless אחרת specified in configuration.
The system must apply measure-specific normalization logic based on the measure type defined in the input schema.
The system must read normalization parameters (e.g., min, max, mean, std, category mappings) from configuration inputs rather than hardcoding values.
The system must return both the normalized value and metadata indicating the normalization method applied.
The system must preserve input measure identifiers in the output to maintain traceability.
The system must support batch normalization of multiple measures in a single request.
The system must handle missing or null input values by returning a null normalized value and a status flag indicating missing data.
The system must raise a validation error when a categorical value is not present in the provided mapping configuration.
The system must raise a validation error when required normalization parameters (e.g., min/max for min-max scaling) are missing.
The system must ensure normalized outputs are bounded within the expected scale (e.g., 0 to 1) after transformation.
The system must support extensibility to add new normalization methods without modifying existing method logic.
The system must log normalization operations with input type, method used, and success or failure status for observability.
